ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a nurse's hands
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: learn enough doctoring to nurse the others

plain.li: [spark:Council_Ail_Survived] Someone sat up with me through the worst of the fever. Next time I want to be the one sitting up.
[spark:hurt] I lay there hurt while everyone looked for the one person who knew what to do. I'm going to learn it myself.
[spark:loss] We lost one of ours, and all I could do was hold the bandages. I'm going to {GOAL}.
I don't need to be a surgeon. I just want to be some use when someone's hurt.
[tribal] The old ones knew which leaves close a wound and which root brings a fever down. I want to know them too.
[medieval] Every village had someone who could set a bone and clean a cut. Ours should have more than one.
[industrial] I want to know what every bottle in the medicine stores is for, and how much, and when.
[spacer] I can read a scan. I want to be able to do something about what it says.

warm.li: When someone's frightened and in pain, they need a steady pair of hands. I'd like mine to be steady.

blunt.li: One doctor isn't enough. I'll learn.

cheerful.li: I've decided I'm going to be the second-best nurse in the colony. The first is taken.

gloomy.li: Someone else will get hurt soon. That's how it goes here. I'd rather know what to do when it happens.

cold.li: A colony with a single healer has a single point of failure. I'll {GOAL}.

plain.li: I sat up with a patient last night and knew what to do the whole time. That's what I wanted.
I cleaned and dressed a wound today without asking anyone how. My hands didn't shake once.
[tribal] I know the leaves now, and the roots, and when to leave a wound alone.

warm.li: The last one I nursed said I have a gentle way with a bandage. I'll take that.

blunt.li: I can nurse the sick now. Call me when you need me.

cheerful.li: I'm a proper nurse. Well, nearly. Proper enough.

gloomy.li: I know enough now to see how close some of them come. I suppose that's the price.

cold.li: The colony has two people who can tend the sick now. Better odds.

plain.li: [spark:hurt] I keep going over how it happened. I'm going to be careful now, and {GOAL}.
[spark:hurt] It still aches when I put weight on it. I'll watch every step until I trust my own feet again.
I've had enough of being the one carried in. A whole month without a scrape, that's what I want.
[tribal] My grandmother said the land bites the careless. I'll walk carefully until it forgets about me.
[child] I'm going to be really, really careful now, every day, until it's a whole month.

warm.li: I gave everyone a fright. The least I can do is not do it again for a while.

blunt.li: No more getting hurt. Thirty days clean, then we'll see.

cheerful.li: Starting today I'm the most careful person in the colony. Watch me.

gloomy.li: It'll happen again, it always does out here. I'd just like a month of not bleeding first.

cold.li: Most hurts come from hurry and habit. I'll change the habits and count the days.

plain.li: Thirty days and not a scratch. I trust my own feet again.
A month without a single hurt. I still look up before I walk under anything, but I don't flinch.

warm.li: Nobody's had to carry me anywhere for a month. I think we're all relieved.

blunt.li: Month's done. Not a scratch.

cheerful.li: A whole month. I'm practically made of stone now.

gloomy.li: A month without getting hurt. Out here that's worth writing down.

cold.li: Thirty days without injury. The care paid for itself.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: keep the colony mended
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: mend forty worn or broken things around the colony

plain.li: Everything around here is a little broken, and nobody minds until it falls apart. I mind. I'm going to {GOAL}.
I walk past three cracked things on my way to breakfast. Starting tomorrow, I stop walking past.
[tribal] A tent that's mended in time outlasts the one who made it. So does a wall.
[industrial] Half our machines are held together with wire and hope. I'd like to replace the hope.
[inherited] {NAME} kept everything here standing. Somebody has to carry on doing it.

warm.li: A mended door that closes properly makes someone's evening better. I'd like to make forty evenings better.

blunt.li: Things break. I fix them. Forty of them.

cheerful.li: I love the click of a thing that works again. I want forty more clicks.

gloomy.li: Everything wears out in the end. I'll keep it going a bit longer than it wants to.

cold.li: Repair costs less than replacement. The colony wastes a great deal by ignoring that.

plain.li: Forty things mended. Nothing in the colony squeaks, rattles or leaks that I know of.
I counted them up. Forty repairs, and every one still holding.

warm.li: People don't notice when things work. That's how I know I've done it right.

blunt.li: Forty fixed. Back to work.

cheerful.li: Forty. The colony runs like a well-oiled cart.

cold.li: Forty repairs completed. The colony's things last longer now.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a trader's name
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: strike six deals with traders for the colony

plain.li: The next caravan that comes through, I'm doing the talking. And the one after that.
[spark:fulfilled] {NAME} has a way with traders. I watched, and I think I can learn it.
[tribal] Trading is just talking with your hands full. I can do that.
[spacer] Every trade ship that calls, I want to be the one at the console.

warm.li: A good deal leaves both sides glad they came. I'd like the traders to be glad to come here.

blunt.li: Six deals. I'll get them.

cheerful.li: I love haggling. It's a game where everyone goes home with something.

gloomy.li: They'll cheat us if we let them. I'd rather it were me they had to get past.

cold.li: Trade is the cheapest way to get what the colony can't make. Someone should be good at it.

plain.li: Six deals struck, and the traders still smile when they see me coming.
That's six. The last caravan master asked for me by name.

warm.li: We've fed people with what I traded for. That's a good feeling.

blunt.li: Six done. I'll keep doing the talking.

cheerful.li: Six deals. I've got the colony a reputation for driving a fair bargain.

cold.li: Six transactions. The colony is better supplied for it.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a friend of the road
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: spend five evenings at the fires of strangers camped nearby
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: spent five evenings at the strangers' fires

plain.li: [spark:Council_Soc_EveningAtTheCamp] I sat at the strangers' fire last night and didn't want to leave. I'd like more evenings like that.
[spark:Council_Moment_CampStories] They told stories from roads I've never walked. I want to hear more of them, every camp that comes.
[spark:Council_Granted_CampEvening] The council let us go to the camp's fire, and it was the best evening I've had here.
Whoever camps near us next, I'll be at their fire with something to share.
[tribal] A stranger who shares your fire is a stranger no longer. That's what my mother said.

warm.li: People on the road get lonely. A friendly face at their fire is the least we can offer.

blunt.li: Next camp, I'm going over. And the one after.

cheerful.li: New faces, new songs, new food. I'll be at every camp's fire I can find.

gloomy.li: They come and they go and we never see them again. I'd like to know a few of them before they do.

cold.li: Travelers know what's happening on the roads. Their fires are worth the walk.

plain.li: Five evenings at five fires, and I remember every one of them. I've friends all down the road now.
That was the fifth camp's fire. I know songs from four peoples now.

warm.li: Some of them will remember us kindly because I sat with them. That matters.

blunt.li: Five fires. Good company, mostly.

cheerful.li: Five. I've eaten things I can't pronounce and loved every bite.

cold.li: Five evenings. I know more about the roads than anyone here now.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a good neighbor
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: answer two of the neighbors' calls for help
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: answered two of the neighbors' calls for help

plain.li: [spark:war] The neighbors are at war, and people out there are going to need help. When they call, I want to be the one who goes.
[spark:Council_Evt_GoodTurn] Someone on the road did us a good turn for nothing. I'd like to pay it forward, twice at least.
When a neighbor sends for help, someone has to answer. Next time it's me.
[lowtech] We'll need our neighbors one day. They should remember that we came when they called.

warm.li: Out here, we're all somebody's neighbor. I'd like ours to be glad of us.

blunt.li: Next time a neighbor calls, I go.

cheerful.li: I want every town on the road to know they can count on us. Starting with me.

gloomy.li: Hard times are coming for everyone. Better they find us helpful than find us closed.

cold.li: A colony that helps is a colony that gets helped. I'll make sure we're owed a favor or two.

plain.li: That's twice the neighbors called, and twice I went. They know my face down there now.
I answered their call again today. When we need help, I know where to send.

warm.li: They thanked me with what little they had. I'd go again for nothing.

blunt.li: Two calls, two answers.

cheerful.li: Twice. We're the good neighbors of the whole valley now.

cold.li: Two calls answered. The neighbors owe us, and they know it.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: keep the colony's days
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see two of the colony's days kept properly
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: saw two of the colony's days kept

plain.li: [spark:Rimfolk_FirstNight] We lit the first fire here and said a few words. Somebody has to remember days like that, and keep them.
[spark:Council_Evt_FoundingDay] The founding day came round and half of us nearly forgot it. Not next time.
[spark:loss] We lose people, and then we lose the days we shared with them. I'm going to keep the days.
A colony is the days it keeps. I'll see the next ones kept properly.
[tribal] The old days are kept by those who remember them. I'll remember.

warm.li: The days we keep together are the ones the children will remember. I want them to be good ones.

blunt.li: Days get forgotten. Not on my watch.

cheerful.li: I'm going to make every day we keep the best one of the season.

gloomy.li: If nobody keeps the days, nobody will remember we were here.

cold.li: Kept days hold a colony together. Someone should take charge of them.

plain.li: Two of the colony's days kept, the table laid and the words said. I'll keep the next ones too.
That's the second day I've seen kept. People came up afterwards to say they were glad of it.

warm.li: Everyone was there, and everyone was glad. That's all a kept day needs.

blunt.li: Two days kept. Properly.

cheerful.li: Two kept days, and both of them lovely.

cold.li: Two days observed as they should be. The habit is forming.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a peacemaker
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: mend three quarrels in the colony

plain.li: [spark:HadAngeringFight] I got into a fight this week and I'm ashamed of it. I'd rather be the one who stops them.
[spark:loss] We lost someone, and two of them still weren't speaking at the grave. That's not how it should be.
There's too much shouting in this colony. I'm going to {GOAL}.
[lowtech] Where I grew up, the one who ended a feud was honored more than the one who won it.

warm.li: Most quarrels are two people who both want to be heard. I can listen to both.

blunt.li: Three quarrels. I'll end them.

cheerful.li: Nothing ends a quarrel like a shared joke and a full plate. I've got both.

gloomy.li: We're too few to hate each other. Somebody has to remind people of that.

cold.li: Grudges cost work and sleep. I'll settle a few of them.

plain.li: Three quarrels mended. Two of them were sharing a table at supper tonight.
That's the third quarrel I've seen ended. The colony is quieter for it.

warm.li: They're talking again. That was all I wanted.

blunt.li: Three done. Less shouting.

cheerful.li: Three. Peace and quiet, and a lot more laughing.

cold.li: Three disputes resolved. The colony works better for it.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: lead the rites
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: lead three of the faith's rites
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: led three of the faith's rites

plain.li: [spark:omen] I dreamt I was leading the rite, and then it came true in other ways. I think it's meant for me.
[spark:loss] We said the words over our dead, and I wanted to be the one saying them. I'll lead the next rites.
The rites hold us together. I'd like to be the one who leads them.
[tribal] The old songs need a voice to carry them. Mine will do.

warm.li: When I lead the rite, I want everyone to feel they belong in it.

blunt.li: I'll lead the rites. Three to start.

cheerful.li: I already know the words. Now I just need everyone to come.

gloomy.li: The faith is all some of us have left. Someone should keep it properly.

cold.li: Rituals done well bind people together. I can do them well.

plain.li: Three rites led to their end. I could see it in their faces: it meant something.
That was the third rite I led. My voice didn't shake once.

warm.li: Everyone came, and everyone left a little lighter. That was the point.

blunt.li: Three rites. Done right.

cheerful.li: Three. And the singing gets better every time.

cold.li: Three rituals completed. The colony's faith is steadier.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: see the new colony grow
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see this colony grow to {COUNT} people
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: saw the colony grow to {COUNT} people

plain.li: [spark:Rimfolk_FirstNight] We lit the first fire here with so few of us around it. I want to see this place full.
[spark:birth] A child born here. That's how a place starts to be a home. I want to see it grow to {COUNT}.
It's a small colony still. I'd like to see the beds filled and the table crowded.
[tribal] A camp of a few becomes a village of many, if the hunting is good and the people stay.
[spacer] We came a long way to start again. I want to see it become a real settlement.

warm.li: Every new face here is one more person to share the evenings with.

blunt.li: We need more people. I want to see {COUNT}.

cheerful.li: More people, more noise, more suppers. I can't wait.

gloomy.li: So few of us. One bad winter and there'd be nobody left. We need to grow.

cold.li: A colony this small can't do everything it needs to. It must grow.

plain.li: The table is full tonight, every seat taken. This is a real colony now.
We're {COUNT} now. I remember when we were a handful round a fire.

warm.li: I don't know everyone's name yet. That's how I know we've grown.

blunt.li: {COUNT} of us. Good. Keep going.

cheerful.li: So many people. I had to wait for a seat at supper and I loved it.

cold.li: The colony has reached a workable size.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: the journey to the other colony
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: make the journey to the other colony
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.deed: made the journey to the other colony

plain.li: [spark:Rimfolk_Parted] We parted at the edge of the old place and I didn't say half of what I meant to. I'm going to go and see them.
[spark:Rimfolk_Uprooted] I didn't choose to be here. I'd at least like to see the old place, and the people in it, once more.
Some of the people I care about most live in the other colony now. I'm going to make the journey.
[tribal] The trail between the two camps should be walked, or it grows over.
[spacer] It's not so far, by the standards of where we came from. I'll go and see them.

warm.li: I miss them. I want to sit at their table, just once, and hear how they're getting on.

blunt.li: I'm going over to the other colony. Soon.

cheerful.li: A trip to see them. I'm already packing in my head.

gloomy.li: If I don't go now, I'll keep putting it off until it's too late.

cold.li: The two colonies should know each other. Someone should make the journey.

plain.li: I made it. We sat up half the night telling each other everything.
I'm at the other colony. It looks different from how I pictured it, and the faces are just the same.

warm.li: They were so glad to see me. I'd do the journey twice over for that.

blunt.li: Made the trip. Good to see them.

cheerful.li: I'm here. The journey was long and every step was worth it.

gloomy.li: I came all this way and it felt like a day. I'll miss them again when I go.

cold.li: The journey is made. The colonies are a little closer for it.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: ready for what comes
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: learn to shoot straight enough to stand on the wall

plain.li: [spark:war] The neighbors are at war. If it comes up our road, I don't want to be the one hiding in the storeroom.
[spark:war] Every traveler brings worse news from the fighting. I'm going to {GOAL}.
[tribal] I'll learn the bow properly. When the drums come, I want to be on the wall.
[medieval] I'll practice at the butts every evening until I can put a bolt where I mean it.
[industrial] I'm going to learn to handle a rifle properly, before anyone needs me to.
[spacer] I've held a gun. I've never needed to hit anything with it. That should change.

warm.li: I'm not a fighter. But I'd stand on the wall for the people here, and I'd rather be some use there.

blunt.li: War's close. I'm learning to shoot.

cheerful.li: It can't hurt to be ready. Besides, I've always wanted to be a good shot.

gloomy.li: Wars spread. It's only a matter of time before this one reaches us.

cold.li: Every pair of hands on the wall is one more reason for raiders to go elsewhere.

plain.li: I can put a shot where I mean it now. If they come, I'll be on the wall.
I practiced until my arms ached, and now I'm a fair shot. I hope I never need to be.

warm.li: If trouble comes, I can stand with the others now. That's what I wanted.

blunt.li: I can shoot. Let them come.

cheerful.li: Bullseye. Well, nearly. Close enough for the wall.

gloomy.li: I'm ready for the war. I'd much rather it never came.

cold.li: I'm a competent shot now. The colony's defense is a little deeper.
